title: Matched IBM OM apparent-noise HWA and deployment-handoff diagnostic
hypothesis: The earlier apparent-accuracy loss attributed to HWA is confounded because its five-step deterministic support-clamp training neither sampled IBM-OM apparent write noise nor shared the direct arm's exact-master deployment target. With a fixed 4,096-example, five-epoch budget, stochastic apparent-noise HWA using the AIHWKit 1.1.0 SoftBoundsReference additive equation will be called beneficial over deterministic support-clamp HWA only if it improves pooled fresh-target apparent accuracy by at least 1.0 percentage point, improves at least two of the three target-assignment means, and makes no target mean more than 2.0 points worse. HWA itself will be called beneficial over the support-clamped no-update control under the same criterion. These decisions are made separately for counterfactually repaired and published-defect populations.
motivation: The reviewed smoke reported higher source apparent accuracy for no training than for continuous HWA when published stuck cells were retained, 93.85% versus 85.65%. Code audit shows that 'continuous HWA' was a deterministic support-clamp straight-through estimator trained for only five minibatches. In addition, the no-training arm programmed the exact teacher target while HWA preclamped every target to source-array support. This study reruns exact no-update, support-clamped no-update, deterministic support HWA, and stochastic apparent-noise HWA on identical source and fresh-target identities. It separates target-handoff loss from optimizer effects and directly tests the user's intended IBM-style forward-noise injection.

completion_criteria: All eight declared configs complete exactly once on the bias-free 784-50-10 analog-MVM--digital-ReLU--analog-MVM network. Every arm uses source assignment 87004 with endpoint streams 89402-89405, fresh target assignments 87005-87007 with four paired endpoint streams each, the first 1000 official MNIST test examples, and no on-chip recovery.

Within each off-chip role, the repaired and published configs differ only in device.corruption_policy. Across roles, teacher checkpoint, model, mapping, controller, source/target assignments, endpoint streams, runtime/data seeds, 4096-example training subset declaration, and evaluation contract are identical. Population masks and sampling seeds are paired by assignment.

The exact no-update arm deploys the unchanged teacher master. The support-clamped no-update arm performs zero optimizer steps and deploys clamp(teacher master, source support). Both save fixed source/master/realized hashes and prove that any accuracy difference is deployment-target handoff rather than learning.

Both trained arms use teacher-KL, digital Adam with logical rates [0.0001,0.0001], betas [0.9,0.999], epsilon 1e-8, five fixed-final epochs, 256 minibatches per epoch, batch size 16, and exactly 1280 optimizer steps over the same deterministic 4096-example ordered cohort. No checkpoint or learning-rate selection is allowed.

Deterministic HWA uses only the source-specific support-clamped persistent q in each forward pass. Stochastic HWA uses q_apparent=q_persistent+write_noise_std*nominal_dw_min*N(0,1), with q_persistent equal to the support-clamped master, write_noise_std=1.4113, nominal_dw_min=0.0949, relative scale 1, one independent full-array draw per minibatch, identity STE, and configured seed 88042 resolved without the corruption-policy name so repaired/published arms share the standard-normal stream.

The stochastic checkpoint and report save the initial and final noise-generator states, resolved seed, per-epoch state hashes, draw counts, tensor-sequence hashes, observed mean/standard deviation/range, and configured sigma q. The report must state that this is AIHWKit 1.1 equation/distribution parity using a replayable PyTorch RNG, not native C++ RNG-stream parity and not a P&V-conditioned endpoint distribution.

Support-only, deterministic-HWA, and stochastic-HWA source deployments use their exact support-clamped persistent targets. Fresh targets are rebuilt from the same fixed-final FP32 master and clamped to each target's own support before P&V; no source realized state, apparent state, or persistent endpoint is copied to a target.

Every source and target assignment reports deterministic no-write mapped accuracy plus all four post-P&V apparent-forward and persistent-q diagnostic accuracies, means/ranges, prediction and state hashes, acceptance/exhaustion/saturation, pulse/read counts, and published/final defect counts. Apparent accuracy is primary under the current simulator inference contract; persistent accuracy remains a programming-state diagnostic.

The study records the exact 4096-example cohort hashes and keeps the prior 16-example/five-step reviewed HWA smoke descriptive only. It does not silently reinterpret the older arm as stochastic HWA or pool old and new optimization budgets.

This remains a first-1000-example AIHWKit-preset simulation. It makes no fabricated-device, fresh-read, retention, drift, endurance, line-resistance, peripheral, or independent-write claim; four endpoint streams on one assignment are repeated programming outcomes, not four arrays.
analysis_plan: Verify artifacts, configuration parity, population seeds/masks, initial teacher/master hashes, training-cohort hashes, fixed step counts, stochastic RNG receipts, transfer mapping rules, and per-endpoint P&V accounting before comparing accuracy. Any mismatch invalidates the paired comparison.

For repaired and published populations separately, report a four-stage table for source A and each fresh target: exact no-update, support-clamped no-update, deterministic support HWA, and stochastic apparent-noise HWA. Show deterministic no-write mapped, post-P&V apparent, and persistent-q diagnostic accuracy without mixing them.

Decompose the earlier no-training-versus-HWA difference additively and endpoint-wise: exact no-update minus support-only is the deployment-handoff/support effect; deterministic HWA minus support-only is the effect of deterministic optimization; stochastic HWA minus deterministic HWA is the effect of IBM-equation forward-noise injection. Do not attribute the first contrast to learning.

Use pooled fresh-target apparent accuracy across the twelve writes only as a programming-outcome summary, while also reporting each of the three target-assignment means as the array-level units. Call stochastic noise beneficial over deterministic HWA only if the pooled improvement is at least 1.0 percentage point, at least two of three target means improve, and no target mean drops by more than 2.0 points.

Apply the same three-part criterion to deterministic and stochastic HWA versus the support-clamped no-update control. If neither passes, report that the tested HWA procedure did not improve deployed apparent accuracy at this fixed budget; do not generalize to all HWA objectives, noise models, budgets, or hardware.

Compare repaired and published results at each stage. Separate healthy-device mismatch from the intervention that retains zero-step stuck cells, and report how many exact/support-clamped requests at corrupt sites are outside their one-point support.

Report source and target persistent-q diagnostics beside apparent accuracy and quantify the apparent-minus-persistent gaps. Because P&V accepts on apparent reads, a strong apparent endpoint with weak persistent state is valid under the current sticky-apparent inference contract but does not establish fresh-read or retention robustness.

Check stochastic-training mechanism directly: configured sigma q=1.4113*0.0949, observed per-epoch noise standard deviations, exact number of full-array draws, RNG replay hashes, and whether the stochastic fixed-final master differs from deterministic HWA. Discuss the mismatch between unconditional training noise and the acceptance-conditioned P&V endpoint distribution.

Use the reviewed 16-example results only as historical context: repaired direct/HWA pooled fresh-target apparent 95.542/95.300%, and published direct/HWA 89.758/83.350%. The new 4096-example results are the decision dataset and must not be pooled with those older values.
